captureMethod: Capture-only scratch project; SessionStart, SessionEnd, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, and PostCompaction wired with blank matchers to a logger that wrote one JSON stdin event per file plus the names (never values) of DEVIN_/CLAUDE_/AIDLC_ environment variables, and emitted no stdout.
sanitization: Replace project paths and host identity with semantic placeholders.
Replace session, prompt, tool-use, agent, and shell identifiers with stable semantic placeholders while preserving correlation.
Remove timestamps and non-load-bearing task, report, prompt, tool-schema, reasoning, and generated-workflow content.
Preserve native field names, nesting, booleans, missing-versus-null distinctions, response status, and classifier strings used by deterministic tests.
limits: Print mode (`devin -p`) only; no attended-session capture on this build.
No AI-DLC workflow was installed in the scratch projects; captures describe the bare host contract.
Model-pinned profiles (a bogus model and `opus`) were NOT refused on this account — both dispatches ran; no failed-start event exists for that cause.

A foreground child's own Stop (identical session_id/prompt_id, stop_hook_active=false) sits between the parent's run_subagent Pre and Post; a `decision:block` on it steers the child (S3) — recorded as narrative, the block is not replayed.
Every PreToolUse hook entry still runs after an earlier entry denies the call (R3b); hook ordering and short-circuit cannot be relied on — recorded as narrative.
A hook-denied run_subagent emits no PostToolUse (R3); the background child's own Stop arrives after the launch ack (C1) and is not replayed — it is covered by the core pending-background carve-out.
